description:
## Problem

`event_at(slot, handler)` (used by the compiler for all `on_*` template attributes) and `register_event_handler(handler)` (used by hoisted `{for}`-loop handlers) both write to the same `new_event_handlers` integer-keyed map, but assign indices through independent mechanisms:

- `event_at` uses compile-time-assigned consecutive slots from `e_ctr` (0, 1, 2...) and never touches `event_handler_index`
- `register_event_handler` uses `event_handler_index`, an auto-increment counter that resets to 0 each render

Result: `register_event_handler` calls inside a `{for}` loop (hoisted by Pass 3 of the VNode compiler into `memo_at` wrappers) start from index 0 and overwrite `event_at` slots that were already written. Any component with both `on_*` attributes and `{for}`-loop `on_*` handlers silently dispatches key events to the wrong handlers.

## Reproduction

A component with any `on_click` (or similar) handler on a non-loop element AND an `on_*` handler inside a `{for}` loop — e.g. a settings modal with an X button and a list of checkboxes. Clicking the X button calls the first checkbox handler instead.

## Fix

In `vnode_compiler.ex`, after `do_walk` computes the final `e_ctr`, prepend a `Filament.Hooks.set_event_handler_floor(e_ctr)` call to the compiled template body:

```elixir
defp assign_and_emit(ast, rv) do
  {result, {_t_ctr, e_ctr}} = do_walk(ast, rv, {0, 0})
  floor_call = quote do: Filament.Hooks.set_event_handler_floor(unquote(e_ctr))
  {:__block__, [], [floor_call, result]}
end
```

In `hooks.ex`, add:

```elixir
def set_event_handler_floor(n) when is_integer(n) do
  case Process.get(:filament_render_context) do
    nil -> :ok
    ctx when ctx.event_handler_index < n ->
      Process.put(:filament_render_context, %{ctx | event_handler_index: n})
    _ -> :ok
  end
end
```

This ensures `register_event_handler` always starts above all `event_at` slots, eliminating any possible collision. ~10 lines total, no wire ref format changes, no breaking changes.
title: Fix event handler index collision between event_at and register_event_handler
